faq_heading: Homes near Edgewood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Edgewood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Edgewood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Edgewood Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Edgewood Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 199 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,650,000, townhomes $823,802, condos $489,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Edgewood Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Edgewood Elementary the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 97.5% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 199 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Edgewood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Grandview Heights Secondary (0.8 km north-east), Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km north-east) and Southridge School (1.5 km north-west).

Edgewood Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16666 23 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Edgewood Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Edgewood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Edgewood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Edgewood Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 199 homes sold within 1 km of Edgewood Elementary: 53 houses, 114 townhomes and 6 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $823,802.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Edgewood Elementary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Edgewood Elementary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Grandview Heights Secondary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Morgan Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Southridge School (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km north-east), Sunnyside Elementary (1.9 km north-west), South Meridian Elementary (2.1 km south-west), Peace Arch Elementary (2.5 km south-west), Jessie Lee Elementary (2.5 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Pacific Heights Elementary, 1.1 km north-east of Edgewood Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Edgewood Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Edgewood Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Edgewood Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 1 km of Edgewood Elementary was $823,802, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Pacific Heights Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.1 km north-east of Edgewood Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
